important_instructions: Applications are accepted online only. Candidates must ensure eligibility before applying. All eligibility details entered in the application are subject to verification. Wrong or false information may lead to cancellation at any stage, including after appointment. Round-off of qualification percentage is not permitted. Candidates should be competent to teach in English and Odia medium where prescribed. Knowledge of computer application is desirable for teaching posts where specified. TGT candidates must possess the prescribed OSSTET/OTET/CTET Paper-II qualification. Candidates with Special B.Ed. or D.Ed. are not eligible for the specified Principal, PGT and TGT posts. Government/Semi-Government/PSU employees must produce NOC at document verification/interview. Original documents along with self-attested copies must be produced at verification. The selected candidate may be posted anywhere in Odisha and cannot claim a posting of choice. Selected candidates must sign a bond to remain in service for at least 2 years from the date of joining. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate. Candidates must carry printed E-Admit Card and valid original Photo ID to the CBT. Mobile phones, pagers, Bluetooth devices and other communication devices are prohibited at the examination centre. PwD candidates eligible for a scribe must arrange their own scribe as per the prescribed conditions. Eligible PwD candidates are allowed compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour of examination. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the Interview. Candidates may respond in either Odia or English during Interview. The number of vacancies may increase or decrease.

TGT Social Studies recruitment is subject to the final outcome of WP(C) No. 7538/2016. PET recruitment is subject to the final outcome of WP(C) No. 14488/2018. Art Teacher recruitment is subject to the final outcome of WP(C) No. 32290/2024.

content_sections.heading: OAVS Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: OAVS has notified 815 regular vacancies across 17 Principal and teaching post categories. The category-wise vacancy table includes UR, SEBC, SC and ST reservations along with women reservation. The notification also provides 15 vacancies for Ex-Servicemen and 6 vacancies under Sports Person reservation. PwD reservation includes 9 posts for Blindness and Low Vision, 9 for Hard of Hearing with suitable aids, 7 for Locomotor Disability and 7 for the specified combination of disability categories.

content_sections.heading: OAVS Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: A candidate must be a citizen of India, be of sound mind and must not have more than one spouse living. Candidates should have passed MIL Odia up to Middle English standard. Candidates who have not passed Odia up to M.E. standard may apply, but they must pass the prescribed Odia examination conducted by BSE Odisha within three years of joining. Candidates must have: Master's Degree from a recognized University with at least 45% aggregate marks. B.Ed. prescribed by NCTE from an NCTE-recognized institution affiliated to a recognized University. Required administrative/teaching experience as specified below. The prescribed experience can be fulfilled through any one of the notified routes: Holding an analogous post or Principal post in Central/State Government or an Autonomous Organization in the prescribed equivalent pay level. Vice-Principal/Assistant Education Officer with combined service of 3 years as PGT and 2 years as Vice-Principal. PGT/Lecturer with at least 7 years of regular service in the prescribed grade. 10 years combined regular service as TGT and PGT, including at least 3 years as PGT. For PGT English, Physics, Chemistry, Biology and Mathematics, candidates should have either a 2-year Integrated Post Graduate Course or Master's Degree in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks, or 45% for SC/ST/SEBC/PwD candidates, along with B.Ed. Candidates need at least 50% aggregate marks, or 45% for SC/ST/SEBC/PwD candidates, in any one of the following: M.Sc. Computer Science / IT MCA M.E./M.Tech in Computer Science / IT Proficiency in teaching through Odia and English medium is required. The notification states that for subsequent promotion, the incumbent has to acquire B.Ed. or equivalent degree. Candidates must have either a 4-year Integrated Degree course in the concerned subject with at least 50% aggregate marks, or 45% for SC/ST/SEBC/PwD, or a Bachelor's Degree in the concerned subjects with the prescribed marks along with B.Ed./3-year integrated B.A. B.Ed. from an NCTE-recognized institution. All TGT candidates must also have passed OSSTET/OTET Paper-II conducted by BSE Odisha or CTET Paper-II conducted by CBSE, as applicable. Candidates should have a Bachelor's Degree in Fine Arts/Visual Arts from a recognized University with the prescribed aggregate marks and proficiency to teach in both Odia and English medium. Candidates should possess a Degree/Post Graduate Degree in Physical Education such as B.P.Ed./M.P.Ed. from a recognized University/Institution and meet the prescribed percentage requirement. Proficiency in Odia and English medium is required. Candidates should have the prescribed marks and any one of the following qualifications: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or IT MCA M.Sc. IT M.Sc. Computer Science DOEACC/NIELIT 'B' Level in Computer Science BCA B.Sc. Computer Science Competence to teach through English and Odia medium is required.
